Wheels, pedals and H-pattern shifters use the axes and buttons reported by your browser. Calibrate a G920 before driving. Steering force feedback is not included.

Choose BIND and press a device button. For an H-pattern shifter, engage each gear once. No active gear signal means neutral.

H-PATTERN

Choose the horizontal and vertical axes, then engage and capture each gear. Positions outside the recorded slots count as neutral.

Logitech Driving Force Shifter: bind 1 to 6 and R, then select H-pattern in Settings. Downshifts and reverse are allowed while moving. A bad shift can damage the gearbox or engine.

Choose BIND KEY, then press a key. A key assigned to another driving action is moved to the new action. Escape cancels capture.

DRIVING GUIDE

CONTROLS.

The prompts follow your active input device. Bindings can be changed under Controls.

A / D STEERW THROTTLES BRAKESPACE HANDBRAKESHIFT NOSC CAMERAI HOLD STARTERCTRL HOLD CLUTCHQ SHIFT DOWNE SHIFT UPN NEUTRALR RESETB HOLD REAR VIEWL HEADLIGHTSH HORNF INTERACTTAB MAPP PAUSEESC MAIN MENU

Engine off? Hold the clutch or select neutral, then hold the starter. An empty tank or failed engine needs service.

Vehicle condition: Check temperatures, oil pressure and individual parts from the pause menu. A missed downshift can drive the engine past its limiter. A slipping clutch heats up; low oil pressure and coolant loss can damage the engine. Repair parts at a mechanic.

Service stops: Stop in a marked bay and press Interact. The map marks fuel stops and mechanics.

Jobs and points: Accept a job on the phone with Interact when you are away from a service bay. Close passes, drifts and escaping police also pay points. Buy cars and parts in the garage.

Map: Mark a road or service to get a route. The round minimap turns with your car; N always marks north.

Club Race: Choose Rookie, Club or Pro and one, three or five laps. Five rivals brake for corners, pass and defend their lines. Pass every checkpoint in order. Track recovery returns you to the last valid sector with a five-second hold. Your car keeps its damage. Retire from Pause if you cannot finish.

Police: Break line of sight and avoid detection during the search. Three stopped seconds beside an officer means arrest.

SIDEWAYS / CITY SESSIONS 12

NEON DISTRICT.

Drive the city, stop for fuel, repair your car and stay clear of police. Club Race, Time Attack and Drift Rush use the separate Dock 09 track. Club Race has five AI rivals, three difficulty levels and finish awards.

Earn points from close passes, drifts, deliveries and escaping police. Spend them on cars, engine swaps and parts. Your installed setup carries over from earlier versions.

The engine and its sound run from MotorLab SDK 1.6.3. Engine internals, cooling, lubrication, clutch, gearbox and differential have separate condition and temperatures. Slipping clutches, hot brakes, low oil pressure and coolant loss change how the car drives. Missing wheels and forced shifts have lasting consequences.

NOS can be opened at rest or on the move, in any gear. Holding it consumes the bottle. A stopped engine gets no extra torque. Driving recharges NOS; a mechanic can refill it.

Downshifts and reverse have no speed lock. A bad shift can overrev the engine or damage the gearbox. Recovery takes you to a service bay. It does not repair the car for you.

Police react to offenses they can detect. Break their line of sight and avoid being spotted until the search ends. The map shows the search area. If you stay stopped near an officer for three seconds, you are arrested. Release puts you outside the station with a roadworthy car.

Night brings more patrols. Speed cameras measure your lane and direction; serious reports send an officer to investigate. Pursuit, search and escape each change the music. Recorded radio calls accompany short status summaries.

The map accepts waypoints and follows roads through the city. Your phone offers deliveries and driving jobs. Accept a job, collect its reward and buy your next setup at a mechanic.

Create a multiplayer lobby and share its eight-character code. Up to four drivers share traffic and police. The host chooses the rules. Short codes use the PeerJS signaling service; some networks also need a TURN relay. If the host leaves, the session ends. A failed connection or loading error stays visible in the lobby with its cause and a copyable report.

Menus lower and filter the music. When the game loses focus, audio fades out unless Background music is enabled.

Look around with the right stick. Hold R3 for the rear view. Release the stick to return smoothly. Headlights, horn, map and service actions have separate bindings.
